description: This file defines the BasketService class, which implements the IBasketService interface to manage shopping basket operations such as adding items, deleting baskets, updating quantities, and transferring baskets between anonymous and user accounts.

classes.name: BasketService
classes.description: Implementation of IBasketService providing business logic for managing shopping baskets.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's basket, creating a new basket if necessary.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket identified by its ID from the repository.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Updates the quantities of items in a basket based on a provided dictionary of item IDs and quantities.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers items from an anonymous basket to a user-specific basket during login or user account association.
